YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

For organizations.

Have a more specific requirement?

Let’s talk↗
Can you support multiple locations?+

GA Digital reports a pan-India presence managed through 11 zonal offices. Contact the team to confirm coverage and arrangements for your specific locations.

What should we include in a staffing enquiry?+

Share the roles, work locations, expected workforce size, skills, proposed start date and engagement duration. The team can then discuss a suitable scope.

Is payroll support available?+

Payroll generation and administration are documented GA Digital capabilities. Their inclusion and responsibilities should be agreed for your engagement.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

For candidates.

Have a more specific requirement?

Let’s talk↗
Are all published jobs still open?+

No. A notice remaining online does not establish availability. Dated roles with past deadlines are marked closed; undated notices are marked availability unconfirmed. Check the vacancy notice and confirm with the company.

How do I apply?+

Open the role page, review the eligibility and follow the vacancy notification’s application process. Different engagements may require different methods.

Does GA Digital charge a job-placement fee?+

The formal notice dated 14 June 2025 states that no job-placement fee is charged. A separate joining notice mentions a refundable joining deposit. Read the full notices and verify any current requirement directly with the company.

Where can I raise a recruitment or employee concern?+

Use the grievance and support page or email info@gadigital.in. Include the project or vacancy reference and a concise description of the concern.
